message: All four named bottom/design interface-G scenarios passed on the actual 362x362x91 explicit 3D thermal grid. Forward and implicit-adjoint linear solves used CUDA float64 with no CPU solve fallback; worst residual 9.813e-11, energy balance 1.304e-11, and Cauchy-normalized reciprocity 1.008e-15. The centered rho=0.5 PTE response is a near-null numerical control, not an optimized or experimental current. Gaussian combined AD-FD and design-window selection still block optimization.
